items.item: dummy.c and doomgeneric.c carry no license header
items.evidence: Two glue files of doomgeneric (dummy.c, 53 lines of stubs; doomgeneric.c, 27 lines) have no license header and no later-version clause. Only the repository license (GPL version 2 text) stands near them. If they are GPL-2.0-only they do not combine with sha1.c (GPL-3.0-or-later) in one binary. Practically they are trivial glue, but the licence side is not clean until the author states it, or both files are replaced by our own glue in the adapter (new build, new hash, new loader). See docs/doom-lizenz.md. Decision by the maintainer on 2026-10-16: ship as is, replace both files if the author objects.
